evidence.title: vibecraft readme
evidence.locator: What you can do; Requirements; Run locally; First5 minutes; Parallel work
evidence.finding: Documents a local spatial agent/folder/terminal/browser workspace for Claude/Codex, source operation on macOS/Windows/Linux and parallel tasks/worktree actions. These source prerequisites are separate from binary availability.

evidence.title: vibecraft src/main/services/agents/claudeCli.ts
evidence.finding: Actual Claude CLI arguments request JSON/stream-json output, permission mode, optional resume ID and prompt. Binary resolves claude or Windows command path.

evidence.title: vibecraft src/main/services/agents/codexCli.ts
evidence.finding: Actual Codex CLI exec arguments set local repo context, JSON output, yolo and optional native resume, using installed codex binary.

evidence.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/Integration/HeroMCP.md
evidence.locator: What the Hero has; Recommended workflow; Practical notes
evidence.finding: Documented Hero orchestrator uses product MCP layout/command operations to create agents/folders, attach workers, inspect progress and send follow-up prompts. It is enabled with MCP skills, not a claim that every workflow auto-delegates.

evidence.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/Buildings/GitWorktrees.md
evidence.locator: Visual creation; Sync from source; Merge to source; Conflict resolution
evidence.finding: Product worktree actions create/sync/merge branches, commit worker WIP, stash source WIP, restore it and surface conflicts. Ordinary file separation is not OS containment.

evidence.title: vibecraft user-docs/Mechanics/SubscriptionAccess.md
evidence.finding: Docs describe a seven-day per-device trial, subscription activation/linking, modal access gate and online confirmation. No subscription amount or billing interval is published in this file.

evidence.title: vibecraft src/main/services/telemetry.ts
evidence.finding: Packaged non-development execution initializes PostHog only if POSTHOG_API_KEY is set. It creates a persistent install ID and sends start/install/heartbeat events. This does not establish which keys are in a released bundle.

evidence.title: vibecraft src/renderer/utils/analytics.ts
evidence.locator: sendEvent lines94-115; heartbeat/session state event methods
evidence.finding: Renderer routes usage events to main telemetry with session ID, screen and workspace ID/name when populated. Source implements collection, so local-first operation is not proof of no telemetry.

evidence.title: vibecraft user-docs/Roadmap.md
evidence.finding: Undated roadmap lists file editor, image capture/send, hotkey editing and process cleanup as long-term work. Unchecked boxes in Done are not treated as unshipped facts.

evidence.title: vibecraft LICENSE
evidence.finding: Main source is Apache-2.0. The application access-service behavior is separately documented.
